scientific_integrity.not_claimed: No independence, publication-priority certification, universal node-count result or comparison to independently audited work is asserted.
scientific_integrity.proof_type: Exact finite-dimensional algebra followed by an algebraic irrationality argument and equidistribution.
scientific_integrity.reproduction: The included verify.py symbolically reconstructs the matrices and checks six leading coefficients, then independently computes nine high-precision sweeps.

scientific_limitations: Exactly two interior Gauss–Legendre nodes and the velocity-Verlet SDC position sweep.
Undamped scalar harmonic oscillator; no claims for damped, nonlinear or higher-dimensional forces.
Constant initial nodal stages; other initializations may have different leading determinant defects.
The small-step claim is for each fixed finite sweep count; no sweep-uniform step interval or finite-step cutoff is asserted.
Density concerns integer sweep counts, not random time steps or arbitrary accuracy requirements.
title: Irrational sweep-phase law for two-node Verlet spectral deferred correction
